description: Make a desktop version of the app for Windows (Mac and Linux are coming, and are refused today): returns a 30-minute download link to a folder the person unzips and double-clicks, plus notes to pass on — above all that the first launch shows an 'unknown publisher' warning because the app is not yet signed. The platform chooses the shape: an app with a database or a server becomes a window onto the online app, updated by every deploy. The app must have a live version.

platform.description: Defaults to windows, the only one available today.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: desktop_app
title: Desktop app
